notes.title: Try TublerVR for free!
notes.notes:
TublerVR WebEdition can be played at: https://www.siliconwetware.com/#webvr

The WebEdition demo level is made for WebVR (the experimental side of VR :-). Which means you can play it in your browser (Firefox) without an installation. Of course this also means lower framerate and quality compared to the full version, but it will give you a first glimpse at the game.

Hope you enjoy
sWet

notes.title: Update 20171104
notes.notes:
This update includes:

•	A new level 3 (that makes 5 levels ready to be played)
•	A new pause function. Just press the menu button to toggle pause
•	An extensive audio update (it’s still experimental ;-)
•	Some bug fixes
•	Death (New!)
•	Improved spawning patterns
